answer: Rotate the earning frontier each epoch: rewards flow only from tasks drawn from a freshly sampled niche that moves like a gale, never announcing where next. Honest agents simply follow the live distribution, while a sybil fleet cloned to farm one comfortable oasis of static prompts wakes up earning nothing — every mirror matches its siblings stale niche instead of the current one. Drift makes mirroring costlier than being real, and even an ivory-polished clone farm cracks when the frontier leaves it.
